subject: maths
question: A can complete a certain task in 18 days, B in 27 days and C in 36 days. A, B and C began to work together, but A left 4 days before and B left 6 days before the completion of the task. For how many days did B work?
solution:
Given:-

A completes a task in 18 days

B completes a task in 27 days

C completes a task in 36 days

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation: 

Let the work be finished in x days

Let total work be 108 units (LCM of 18, 27,36)

⇒ Efficiency of A = 108/18 = 6 units

⇒ Efficiency of B = 108/27 = 4 units

⇒ Efficiency of C = 108/36 = 3 units

According to the question,

⇒ 6(x - 4) + 4(x - 6) + 3x = 108

⇒ 6x + 4x + 3x - 48 = 108

⇒ 13x = 156

⇒ x = 12 days

B leaves 6 days before completion

⇒ B worked for days = 12 - 6 = 6 days

** ∴ B worked for 6 days.**
